title: German Shepherd Dog in Backyard, 1956 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white mid-century snapshot dated August 1956 capturing an alert German Shepherd sitting attentively on a low outdoor surface in a grassy suburban backyard. The background features a ping-pong table, wicker lawn furniture, and mesh fencing, reflecting mid-20th-century suburban pet ownership and family leisure activities.
